statement: Frozen RIG-1B historical acceptance suite. Each case is reconstructed ONLY from its historical BASE (the merge's first parent) and HEAD (the merge commit); no present-day topology is used. Expected scopes are the RIG-1B frozen classifications, fixed before RIG-1C was implemented. Advisory evidence only: RIG has no CI authority.
